{{Quote|I always dance for my audience as if all that I did were to please them, but inside, I dance only for myself.|Manaroo|<ref name="Payback" />}}
'''Manaroo''' was an [[Aruzan/Legends|Aruzan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] dancer from [[Aruza/Legends|Aruza]]. The daughter of a landowner named [[Abano]], Manaroo traveled [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] from a young age, competing in dance competitions across the [[Star/Legends|stars]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], she was rescued from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]] forces on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]]. Manaroo aided the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] hunter on numerous adventures in his quest to catch the elusive [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. She and Dengar later [[Marriage/Legends|married]] after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|On my world, when two people love each other, they share more than their bodies. They do more than take pleasure with each other. They bond with the Attanni, sharing their thoughts and emotions completely, sharing their memories and knowledge. All of the subterfuges between them are stripped away, and they become one person. On Aruza I was bonded to three good friends, but now&hellip;|Manaroo, to Dengar, in 3 ABY|<ref name="Payback" />}}
Manaroo was an [[Aruzan/Legends|Aruzan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aruza/Legends|Aruza]]. She was raised by her [[Parent/Legends|father]] [[Abano]], a low-level [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrat]], and a [[Manaroo's mother|mother]] who made [[Clay/Legends|clay]] diningware. Manaroo's talent for dancing emerged early, earning her winning placements in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] competitions at the age of nine. She was well-traveled; on one ocassion, she rafted through a storm on the planet [[Bengat]], and on another she survived an encounter with [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] aboard a [[Passenger liner/Legends|starliner]]<ref name="Payback" />

Growing up on Aruza, Manaroo tended to [[dola tree]]s on her family's [[Farm/Legends|farm]], coaxing the [[Sentience/Legends|near-sentient]] [[Plant/Legends|plants]] to release a substance that Aruzan [[Doctor/Legends|physicians]] developed into an antibiotic [[Syrup/Legends|syrup]]. Manaroo grew in understanding of her people through the [[Attanni]], [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] implants designed on her world that allowed users to share their emotions, senses, and experiences with others. In her time on Aruza she bonded deeply with three close friends through the Attanni and grew to consider many Aruzans to be her family.<ref name="Payback" />

===Meeting Payback===
Manaroo was to undergo Imperial processing on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] "Redesign" operation. Under [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]], the process would remove all kindness from her being, effectively making her a vicious servant of Imperial doctrine. It would be similar to the process undergone by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]]. Manaroo was rescued by Dengar, who killed [[Sinick Kritkeen]], the COMPNOR overseer of Aruza. She made her way to [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] to become a dancer.

Soon, Dengar came to Cloud City while hunting [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. Manaroo told Dengar that Solo had been captured by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. Once Manaroo finished talking to Dengar, Lando announced over the loudspeaker that stormtroopers were invading. She was captured by Imperials, from which Dengar freed her and took her with him to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to recapture Han Solo. While Dengar was away, Manaroo danced at a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], but a [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] working for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], specifically one with a large pouch in its belly he used to hold her captive in, captured and presented her to the bloated [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] as a slave. While in Jabba's service, she was forced to dance while wearing violet leggings and a revealing top. On the night Dengar and Fett were at the Palace she danced while playing a golden flute. After Jabba's [[Death/Legends|death]] on board the [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]], Manaroo was freed.

[[File:ManarooJumpMaster5000-XWM.png|thumb|left|250px|Manaroo and Dengar fly over the sarlacc in the Pit of Carkoon]]
Afterward, she looked for Dengar, who had been sentenced to "feel [[the Teeth of Tatooine]]," a [[Torture/Legends|torture]] that mainly caused death; captives were left out in a valley during a sandstorm to be impaled to death or mortal injury upon the sharp rocks. She nursed Dengar back to health and traveled with him to scavenge the sail barge wreck. To their surprise, they found the [[Sarlacc/Legends|Sarlacc]] dead and a half-dead Boba Fett lying near it. Manaroo stopped Dengar from killing Boba from anger of his abuse to him and instead treated the wounded bounty hunter. Once Fett recovered, Manaroo settled down with Dengar, who asked Fett to be the best man for their [[Marriage/Legends|wedding]].
